# 功能法案

## capabilityDomain: ai-input-gateway

### [LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-001-V1] 现役业务约束

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "src/capabilities/ai-input-gateway/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "ai-input-gateway",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.ast",
    "static.contract",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：business plugins importing provider adapters, provider SDKs, provider DOM, browser selectors, coordinates, tab ids, or browser commands",
    "不得发生：AI Input Gateway making business judgments or validating domain output meaning",
    "不得发生：maxInputChars, a prompt character/byte/token ceiling, a prompt budget increase, prompt splitting, or any local prompt-capacity rejection before the real provider window",
    "不得发生：a second provider transport owner, compatibility transport wrapper, provider-specific business API, parallel GPT page-control chain, or title-housekeeping worker",
    "不得发生：a production profile default, legacy caller normalization, compatibility profile reader, or proof minted for a request that did not carry the canonical profile"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-001-V1",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须保持以下不变量：AI Input Gateway is the single provider-transport owner and must preserve a provider-agnostic public request contract.",
  "supersedesLawId": null,
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

### [LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-002-V3] 现役业务约束

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "src/capabilities/ai-input-gateway/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "ai-input-gateway",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.ast",
    "exam.golden",
    "dynamic.browser",
    "dynamic.provider",
    "dynamic.authorization"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：reading cookies, browser storage, passwords, tokens, or hidden credentials",
    "不得发生：automatic login, CAPTCHA bypass, account rotation, security-barrier bypass, or unbounded retry",
    "不得发生：patrol, submission or another task reacquiring the provider target while any plugin takeover owner remains active",
    "不得发生：parallel or detached BrowserTargetLease commands within one provider page operation",
    "不得发生：把顺序动作解释为一次聚合 AND、先预读尚未轮到的后续状态再回头执行、在多个步骤之间往返探测、用一个 task-wide deadline 等齐接单、开页、选模型、附件与提交，或在前一步专属 proof 未成立时启动后一步；每个已解析前态只能触发一个 THEN 动作，该动作后置 proof 只能成为紧邻下一步 IF，精确语义、candidate_count=1 与相邻错误态排除只用于证明当前 IF；也不得由后一张 page-action proof 解析先前无关 mutation、在前一 mutation 未解析时执行第二 mutation、用 substring 识别精确语义或把 fixed sleep 当作生产转换。",
    "不得发生：用 document-global、隐藏、detached、折叠区或非当前 expanded container 的 DOM 节点证明当前 IF，或使用通用 selector fallback；当前原子步骤只能读取本步必要的最小事实，以及可见、有几何尺寸、属于当前打开容器的精确候选，0 个表示未就绪只读等待，1 个才允许一个 THEN，大于 1 个失败关闭；fresh 页面就绪只证明 ChatGPT 根 URL 与唯一可见空 composer，不得预读尚未进入附件步骤的 file input、附件卡、turn、generation 或全局 form 分母，也不得因这些可选节点尚未出现而重跑整组观察。",
    "不得发生：downgrading or erasing a completely captured provider response because later title, artifact or cleanup work failed",
    "不得发生：using application activation, whichever Chrome window is foreground, accessibility window ordering, or a second physical provider tab as page identity"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-002-V3",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须使 Web-chat provider 在 exact target/document 上按逐原子 IF -> AND（那么）-> 单一 THEN 直线推进；每个 IF 只读取本步必要的最小事实和当前 expanded container 内可见且几何成立的唯一候选，fresh 就绪只认根 URL 与唯一可见空 composer，0 个只读等待、1 个执行一次、大于 1 个失败关闭，后置 proof 才成为下一步 IF，禁止预读、往返、全局 DOM 计数、selector fallback 和 task-wide timeout。",
  "supersedesLawId": "LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-002-V2",
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

### [LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-003-V1] 现役业务约束

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "src/capabilities/ai-input-gateway/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "ai-input-gateway",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.ast",
    "static.contract",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：transport kind, provider selector, DOM selector, coordinate, tab id, picker instruction, or fallback policy in the public request",
    "不得发生：switching transport after an attachment attempt starts",
    "不得发生：retrying the same file through clipboard, native picker, focus lease, OS accessibility action or any second upload path",
    "不得发生：a detached provider-input-preflight caller, HTTP route, temporary chat, capacity waiter, base64 file envelope, upload-clear-reupload sequence, or any second attachment action graph",
    "不得发生：an HTTP request-body or per-file byte ceiling used to admit governed provider files",
    "不得发生：accepting a lower-bound attachment count or a page URL, file input, attachment name or attachment count that is not exact",
    "不得发生：a local file byte ceiling, token estimate, token budget, threshold increase or file splitting rule that blocks an otherwise governed file before the real provider window decides whether it can accept it"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-003-V1",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须保持以下不变量：attach-approved-web-chat-files-once is the only web-chat attachment child and selects one fixed internal transport without caller choice or same-attempt fallback.",
  "supersedesLawId": null,
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

### [LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-004-V1] 现役业务约束

```law-record
{

    "不得发生：count-only success without exact names and composer scope",

  "tier": "P0"
}
```

### [LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-005-V4] 现役业务约束

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "src/capabilities/ai-input-gateway/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "ai-input-gateway",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.ast",
    "static.contract",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：a global browser lease held from provider open through response capture",
    "不得发生：a second physical ChatGPT tab, per-task tab lease or provider-tab pool",
    "不得发生：refreshing/reloading ChatGPT after rate-limit acknowledgement or as a no-result recovery action",
    "不得发生：clearing an unmarked or ambiguously owned composer, or treating a root draft as owned without exact marker evidence",
    "不得发生：routing, retrying, deduplicating, continuing, forking or recovering a task from provider title text",
    "不得发生：binding or routing a transient /c/WEB: URL as a canonical conversation",
    "不得发生：same-origin tab fallback, active/front/first tab selection, foreground-window dependence or offscreen blind click",
    "不得发生：in-memory-only submission priority, unordered submission or patrol races, preserving a dead-process waiter without a current eligible Cloud grant, or releasing a live current-grant submission ticket before checkpoint or terminal proof",
    "不得发生：fixed reasoning-slider indexes, coordinate-to-reasoning arithmetic, model fallback, reasoning downgrade, caller split model/reasoning controls after production admission, or profile proof that does not match the hashed semantic profile",
    "不得发生：caller-supplied chat title, title text derived from prompt/user/report content, machine title used as primary identity, title search used as final route proof, rename debt worker, periodic title housekeeping or a second title owner",
    "不得发生：publishing a title-managed production GPT checkpoint before exact profile/title proof exists",
    "不得发生：detaching provider post-processing as fire-and-forget work after checkpoint publication",
    "不得发生：using stale BrowserDocumentRef coordinates after navigation or DOM document replacement",
    "不得发生：page-global last-response extraction, legacy turn selectors, screenshot-as-output, or generated-image selector fallbacks",
    "不得发生：a failed execution state without durable phase/classification/recoverability/reason evidence",
    "不得发生：reopening any legacy technical failure that has any submission, upload, page-action, UNKNOWN mutation, checkpoint or output proof"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-005-V4",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须保持以下不变量：GPT Web uses one Session Controller to bind task identity, semantic execution profile, exact conversation topology, bounded page actions and compulsory privacy-safe title finalization without making titles a routing identity.",
  "supersedesLawId": "LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-005-V3",
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

## capabilityDomain: app-shell-ui

### [LAW-APP-SHELL-UI-001-V2] 现役业务约束

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "src/app/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "app-shell-ui",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.ast",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：Legacy one-page home UI remaining as production entry.",
    "不得发生：Second App Shell or hidden parallel UI shell.",
    "不得发生：Skill list hardcoded outside Skill Registry.",
    "不得发生：非玄学业务详情、历史表格或旧模块入口重新进入 App Shell UI。",
    "不得发生：Runtime Console replaced by business history table.",
    "不得发生：Shell、Cloud control plane、link、contract、worker session、Browser Authority、Browser Target、Browser lane、claim admission、queue/outbox 或 e2e proof 被合并为单一绿色 ready。",
    "不得发生：Cloud 凭证、Provider 或 Browser 未就绪时隐藏真实 block reason 或使诊断状态页不可用。",
    "不得发生：UI using localStorage, fixture rows, package scanning, or log parsing as production truth.",
    "不得发生：UI computing AI verdict or product opportunity score.",
    "不得发生：UI 暴露玄学生产状态、诊断、人工介入与恢复之外的业务动作。"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-APP-SHELL-UI-001-V2",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须由唯一 Workbench Shell 分开展示 Shell、Cloud、合同、session、Browser、claim、outbox 与 E2E 真实状态，任一局部 ready 不得冒充端到端 ready，失败时诊断面仍必须可用。",
  "supersedesLawId": "LAW-APP-SHELL-UI-001-V1",
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

## capabilityDomain: architecture-boundary

### [LAW-ARCHITECTURE-BOUNDARY-001-V1] 玄学单线架构与公共边界

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "scripts/**",
    "src/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "architecture-boundary",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [],
  "enforcementMode": "static",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.filesystem",
    "static.ast",
    "static.types",
    "static.dependency"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：除 xuanxue-ai-production 外的第二 active business plugin 或旧业务 source root 进入生产主链。",
    "不得发生：Mediator 执行业务步骤、浏览器动作或能力私有实现。",
    "不得发生：Plugin 绕过 public capability facade 导入 child runtime、私有协议或基础设施实现。",
    "不得发生：Capability 导入 Plugin、隐藏业务 workflow 或跨能力读取私有 runtime。",
    "不得发生：src/lib、src/types、scripts/startup、scripts/acceptance 或 scripts/audit 越权承担业务编排。",
    "不得发生：public facade 泄漏私有实现类型、浏览器内部协议、selector、coordinate 或 provider 私有对象。",
    "不得发生：旧 source root、第二 mediator、兼容桥、平行入口或无期限 adapter 保持可达。"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-ARCHITECTURE-BOUNDARY-001-V1",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须保持玄学需求经唯一 Mediator、xuanxue Plugin、公共 Capability facade、Child Ability、Evidence/Log/Result 的单线架构，并使每个 source root 只有一个职责和一个 Owner。",
  "supersedesLawId": null,
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

## capabilityDomain: capability-governance

### [LAW-CAPABILITY-GOVERNANCE-001-V2] 能力原子性与 Facade

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    ".github/instructions/agent-rules/功能法案.md",
    ".github/instructions/agent-rules/基础法案.md",
    "src/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "capability-governance",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [
    "LAW-ARCHITECTURE-BOUNDARY-001-V1"
  ],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.filesystem",
    "static.ast",
    "static.types",
    "static.dependency",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：能力组同时承担不同种类动作、业务决策、步骤顺序或终态裁决。",
    "不得发生：Child Ability 隐藏多步 workflow、跨 Owner 调用或直接返回业务最终结果。",
    "不得发生：消费者绕过唯一 public facade 导入非 facade 文件或 private runtime。",
    "不得发生：Capability 使用 shared/common/utils/service/manager/facade/bridge/adapter 名称隐藏无 Owner 逻辑。",
    "不得发生：没有真实玄学生产 consumer 的能力、export、registry entry 或动态入口被当作在用。",
    "不得发生：能力 inventory 恢复 Amazon、video、media 或其它非玄学历史业务。"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-CAPABILITY-GOVERNANCE-001-V2",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须使每个 Capability 只提供同类、原子、类型明确的动作，经唯一公共 Facade 暴露，并以玄学生产调用图证明每个能力和导出真实在用。",
  "supersedesLawId": "LAW-CAPABILITY-GOVERNANCE-001-V1",
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

## capabilityDomain: local-app-shell

### [LAW-LOCAL-APP-SHELL-001-V5] 现役业务约束


## capabilityDomain: xuanxue-ai-production

### [LAW-XUANXUE-AI-PRODUCTION-001-V12] 现役本地订单执行约束

```law-record

  "appliesTo": [
    "scripts/startup/xuanxue-ai-production-cloud-enroll.ts",
    "src/app/workbench-api-boundary.ts",

    "LAW-LOCAL-APP-SHELL-001-V5",
    "LAW-LOCAL-BROWSER-SESSION-001-V4",
    "LAW-STARTUP-ENTRYPOINT-001-V4"
  ],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.ast",
    "static.contract",
    "exam.golden",
    "exam.property",
    "exam.state-machine",
    "dynamic.browser",
    "dynamic.service",
    "dynamic.database",
    "dynamic.storage",
    "dynamic.provider",
    "dynamic.authorization",
    "dynamic.recovery"
  ],
  "excludes": [
    "src/capabilities/ai-input-gateway/acceptance/**"
  ],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：V5 active reader writer validator route config package entry or process",
    "不得发生：Browser Workspace Authority Target Document selector command mutation journal Browser command TTL or wall-clock Workspace TTL in the Cloud contract",
    "不得发生：device credential used for claim renew checkpoint terminal or material access",
    "不得发生：session credential persisted logged displayed or given to Extension",
    "不得发生：two claim-eligible sessions for one device",
    "不得发生：stale attestation or absent Browser capability receiving browser-required lease",
    "不得发生：HTTP 200 empty jobs or partial ready presented as end-to-end readiness",
    "不得发生：Cloud credential、Provider、Browser 或 worker session 失败时销毁唯一诊断 Shell；仅 execution 与 claim 可失败关闭",
    "不得发生：xuanxue external HMAC LNA localhost business ingress or Cloud callback",
    "不得发生：second worker mediator scheduler queue ledger Browser Provider contract owner or transport",
    "不得发生：service class recovery partition registration order or in-memory ordering bypassing globally oldest eligible work",
    "不得发生：automatic replay of UNKNOWN or replacement job prompt for a recoverable original",
    "不得发生：alias default normalization compatibility fallback shadow bridge dual reader or dual writer",
    "不得发生：stale foreign or caller-minted Chrome Provider candidate receipt",
    "不得发生：provider commit/hash、provider contract bytes、产品 bundle 或 generated projection 固定在 consumer 仓库、长期 device credential、session 或 runtime attestation；AGENT-owned Product Execution canonical source、cross-job graph、business verdict、handwritten product map、successor Cloud Job 或 runtime Stage improvisation；或 Cloud grant、local order、checkpoint、terminal 与 result 的 product_contract_hash 身份不一致",
    "不得发生：Static Contract Integration Fault Real Chrome Real Provider or bounded runtime observation substituting for another evidence layer, or using historical fixed scenario counts and fixed 72h waiting as daily claim admission",
    "不得发生：isolated-test、test-mode、阶段态、过程态或任何非 production device、credential、queue、state、storage identity 或环境选择器",
    "不得发生：把 AGENT 部署到网站服务器或纳入网站、PostgreSQL、systemd 的部署与进程所有权；当前同一台 Mac 只代表网络同机，不改变 AGENT 独立执行端身份",
    "不得发生：renew 瞬时网络失败立即 terminal，或已确认 lease/fence 丢失后孤儿 execution 继续 Browser/Provider/Cloud mutation；每 job 必须由同一结构化生命周期拥有 renew、abort、settle 与 active cleanup",
    "不得发生：production_cloud_claim_ledger 重复保存 grant truth，或 production_interventions/Workbench pause-cancel-takeover-resume 复制网站 ControlIntentV6 状态机"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-XUANXUE-AI-PRODUCTION-001-V12",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须让本地 Mac 上唯一 production AGENT 只消费经过鉴权的 immutable Cloud order；每 job 由一个结构化生命周期持有 renew、execution、abort、settle、checkpoint 与 outbox，grant 与 Local Order 同事务持久化，控制只消费网站 ControlIntentV6。网站与 PostgreSQL 同机、AGENT 独立，产品合同、跨 Job graph 与业务完成唯一归网站，阻断不得杀死诊断 Shell。",
  "supersedesLawId": "LAW-XUANXUE-AI-PRODUCTION-001-V11",
  "tier": "P0"
}
```
